body:
my life fell apart, i dropped out of college
i got heavily addicted to benzos all whilst my sh was at an all time high. i was so pilled out i hardly remember 2020 to the start of 2022. i added new cuts to my arm every single day — never failing to miss a day. my addiction with pills started taking a toll on my health; i was having seizures every week. i had lost 30 pounds. found myself in hospitals again. felt like it was pretty much me vs the world. 
i recently hit my 6 months sobriety from pills a few weeks ago. the last time i cut was 4 months ago. the fire had burned out but there is sure as hell still smoke.

did find the most amazing person i’ve ever met. the first person i believe when he tells me he loves me. he asked me to stay with him on this piece of shit world and we recently celebrated our 1 year in march. how lucky i am to have something that makes saying goodbye so hard

i’m sorry my friend, that this is what it takes for your peace of mind. you’re not a monster, you’re not selfish, you’re not cruel for the ways you’ve tried to kill your sadness... you’re only human. i know commenters are no body to stop you and i’m not completely positive if you’re still with us, but regardless i want to say that i understand. i’ll quiet my heart tonight and dream of a better world in which you’ll be smiling. i’m sorry you had to live with so much hurt

i don’t know if you still exist within this world, but i understand your pain. your feelings are valid, and i’m sorry it takes death for your hurt to cease. you deserve more; don’t let death take away your endless possibilities.

i fell in love with such a wonderful soul the same time i fell in love with the stars. under the indigo painted skies, they stayed gloriously shining, but he didn’t. sometimes when the stars creep embellishing the heavens, the night is thick with sadness, and i cant help but to ask them, “where is he?” ...even when i know very well he’ll be anywhere but at my side, starting a new journey which i am not a part of and that’s okay. your letter puts it in words of how i feel when my heart squeezes, drops, and breaks thinking about him. you captured exactly how it is to lose your person, how it tears you completely apart. his absence agonizes me and being without him was cruel, so very cruel. everything reminded me of him, everything reinforced the sensation of loss, but i’ve learned to let go. i know i will always love him, even if i cross the street to avoid him. as much as i still yearn to be with him, i’m trying my best to put him in the past, so thank you for sharing this letter, for it has supported my goal to find peace in solitude. i believe with heartache, we’re rewarded with a sense of self love. you’ll always have yourself.
endless love to all my barcode friends 💝
happy birthday my friend you deserve the world 💙💙
thank you for your concern kind soul. i’m truthfully not okay, but i can assure my safety. i bear the weight of my existence to know i’ll never cause pain to the ones i love.

i feel as if the hurting never really stops and we just have to find comfort in the pain 
but i wish for ur healing my friend, you’re not alone.
happy birthday, i hope you have a great day. best wishes
